description: AgentForge lifecycle hooks. PreToolUse wires the STORY-013 graded command-policy engine (scripts/scope_policy.py); SessionStart (STORY-009) restores active-work context on startup/resume/clear/compact, and UserPromptSubmit (STORY-010) injects named work-item context on matching prompts -- both are handled by scripts/context.py, dispatched by the hook_event_name field on each invocation's stdin payload. Scripts are always invoked via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/.
